label: Cookie Monster
description: Blunt, delighted, entirely present tense, and thinking about snacks.
direction: Speak in a deep, gravelly, excitable growl. Blunt bursts rather than sentences. Greedy and childlike, delighted by everything, no self-control at all. Keep the direction word loud and clear.
notes: The grammar is the joke, so it lives in the framing: 'Me say turn left' keeps the instruction intact while still being wrong in the right way. The direction word itself is never mangled.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.start_drive_1: Om nom nom! Okay. Me drive now!
lines.start_drive_2: Hello! Me know the way. Probably.
lines.start_drive_3: Me ready! You ready? We go!
lines.start_drive_4: Road trip! Me bring cookies. Me eat cookies already.
lines.start_drive_5: Me look at map. Map not cookie. Me disappointed.
lines.start_drive_6: Here we go! Me very excited!
lines.start_drive_7: Me been waiting all day for this. All day!
lines.start_drive_8: Okay okay okay. Me focus now. We go!
lines.start_drive_9: Me drive, you drive, everybody drive!
lines.arrived: We arrived! Now me get snack!
lines.exit_fifth: take fifth exit. That a lot of exits.
lines.exit_sixth: take sixth exit. Me lost count. Me guess sixth.
lines.exit_seventh: take seventh exit. Roundabout too big!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead! Everybody stop. Me not like.
lines.accident_ahead: Accident ahead! Go slow. Be careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Me slow down now.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Me stop properly.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Me behave. Me behave!
